# alankennedy.dev

> Portfolio of Alan Kennedy, full stack developer based in Corrientes, Argentina.

This is a static site with no API. Every page is served as HTML by default, or as Markdown when the request sends `Accept: text/markdown`.

## Pages

- [Portfolio (Spanish)](https://alankennedy.dev/): experience, projects, education, contact
- [Portfolio (English)](https://alankennedy.dev/en/): same content in English
- [OpenAPI description](https://alankennedy.dev/openapi.json)
